question: What did Brahma do himself after realizing the presence within him?
premises: After knowing, Brahma himself performed an offering.
The offering was directed to the imperishable.
inference: After realizing, Brahma himself made an offering to the imperishable.
uncertainties: Whether avyayam qualifies the oblation or the recipient is not explicit.
plain_english: Then Brahma, having known for himself, himself offers to the imperishable.
